blocks.text: As its name suggests, this package shows you a bit of everything: a potpourri of the most beautiful destinations in Costa Rica, from Poás Volcano and the canals of Tortuguero to Arenal, the cloud forest of Monteverde, Manuel Antonio and the wild Osa Peninsula, with Corcovado and Caño Island.
